caption: The drawing features a dark-colored metal trivet with a handle, depicted in three views: a large three-quarters perspective in the lower right, a smaller top-down view in the upper left, and a side elevation showing its supporting legs below the top-down view. The trivet is elongated with an overall fish-like shape, and its main body consists of a large star pattern formed by intersecting bars and six points radiating from the center. The handle is a simple curved loop extending from the narrow end. Three cut-out holes of varying sizes and a heart-shaped cutout are positioned along the broader end of the trivet. The drawing is done on a beige background, and a small scale in feet is included beneath the top-down view. The artist's name, "P. Johnson," is printed in small letters in the bottom left corner.
title: Flat Iron Holder
